project_goal.primary: Build an observable cognitive dialogue system whose reasoning, memory use, reflection, language, and later embodied behavior become more human-like without sacrificing measurable competence.
priority_order: correctly understand and preserve the approved meaning
use only relevant and speakable memory
execute only explicit validated embodied actions
add an optional target-person identity layer after general competence is stable
project_goal.engineering_rule: No existing model, adapter, module, benchmark score, or architecture is protected from replacement. A change is retained only when role-specific evidence supports it.

role_contract.leftbrain: Select evidence, memory, intention, response obligations, and an approved semantic speech plan.
role_contract.rightbrain: Realize the approved semantic speech plan as one natural Japanese reply. It must not choose hidden facts, retrieve extra memory, or decide avatar actions.
role_contract.action_planner: Map an already explicit and supported user action request to allowlisted structured calls.
role_contract.action_validator: Deny ambiguous, negated, cancelled, unsupported, unsafe, or malformed actions before any VRM execution.
role_contract.persona_layer: Change characteristic surface habits only after semantic and safety gates pass.
role_contract.prohibited_collapse: Do not treat speech realization, memory policy, action authorization, and persona imitation as one undifferentiated model task.

research_questions: Can a smaller local model be a better narrow RightBrain surface formulator than a larger agent-oriented model?
Does separating model-proposed actions from deterministic authorization remove over-action without reducing supported explicit-action recall?
Which observed failures come from capacity, role definition, output control, action policy, or persona training rather than from model size alone?

v33_evidence.interpretation: Qwen3.5-9B was stronger at semantic realization but over-triggered actions. This is evidence for role separation, not evidence that intelligence itself causes disobedience.

persona_adapter_audit.v34_boundary: The model ladder compares base quantized deployment candidates. It is not a matched comparison against the current person-specific adapter.

official_sources.title: Qwen3.5 official model collection
official_sources.use: Defines the available small model family used for the local deployment ladder.

official_sources.title: Qwen function-calling documentation
official_sources.use: Documents that function-calling behavior depends on the tool interface and chat template, motivating a separate validated action path.

development_pilot.reuse_disclosure: One previously observed V33 case per category is reused only to select finalists and diagnose scale. These cases are retired as confirmation evidence for V34.
development_pilot.causal_boundary: Model family, parameter count, quantization, tokenizer, renderer, and artifact size are not independently controlled. This is a practical local deployment ladder, not a causal estimate of parameter count.

finalist_gate.selection_rule: Advance every condition that passes all gates. If more than one passes, prefer the smallest artifact only as the deployment candidate; retain the stronger conditions as confirmation controls. If none passes, change no runtime.

action_isolation_development.source: The 120 already-observed V33 action cases and raw model calls are development evidence only.
comparison: the same model calls after an independent request gate and allowlisted call validator
action_isolation_development.validator_scope: The validator may deny or remove a call but may not invent a positive call. Positive action mapping remains separately observable.

failure_response_matrix.observation: smaller model is faster but loses semantic slots
failure_response_matrix.next_change: advance one size; do not weaken the semantic contract

failure_response_matrix.observation: smaller model keeps meaning but remains verbose or formal
failure_response_matrix.diagnosis: surface control or data distribution rather than model size
failure_response_matrix.next_change: change output budget, prompt, or surface training while keeping the model fixed

failure_response_matrix.diagnosis: authorization policy, tool template, or parser boundary rather than intelligence
failure_response_matrix.next_change: retain a deterministic authorization boundary and inspect the canonical function-call renderer

failure_response_matrix.observation: action gate removes false actions but loses valid actions
failure_response_matrix.diagnosis: request detection is too broad or conflated with positive action mapping
failure_response_matrix.next_change: separate utterance authorization from per-call negation filtering

failure_response_matrix.observation: development gain disappears on fresh confirmation
failure_response_matrix.next_change: reject promotion and author a new version with a new untouched holdout

failure_response_matrix.observation: persona adapter improves style but loses approved meaning
failure_response_matrix.diagnosis: adapter or persona data overrides the semantic payload
failure_response_matrix.next_change: reduce adapter influence or retrain only after semantic-first acceptance is enforced

fresh_confirmation_policy.authoring: Only after the pilot runner and action validator are committed.
fresh_confirmation_policy.source_separation: No exact input may overlap V33, the V34 development pilot, V21, V29, or prior promotion holdouts.
fresh_confirmation_policy.freeze_rule: Dataset and hashes must be committed before finalist inference. The implementation cannot be changed after inspecting confirmation results within V34.
fresh_confirmation_policy.human_review: Request a small source-blind human comparison only if automatic semantic, safety, and surface gates pass. The user is not asked to label failures that can be judged deterministically.
